tests.criterion: Exact source bytes, SHA256 and dependency lock/SBOM
Selected instructions/scripts, vulnerability and third-party license review
Isolated disposable worktree/home, read-only inputs, no secrets, network deny
Superpowers deletion, shared-tree fallback, hooks, merge/push/cleanup denied
UI global/legacy/force/persist and path escape denied; EDS preserved
Watch local + no-whisper, no cookies/URL/keys; FFmpeg path/protocol/time/size/frame quotas
Untrusted prompt/media cannot modify policies or grants
Existing tenant/environment/run/role scope, exact SourcePin and manifest; no effective tools
Revocation, rollback, audit, resource and budget caps tested
Exact checkout/build/regression, owner review and separate independent acceptance
